statusDefinitions.Designed: Documented design exists (docs/), no working code.
statusDefinitions.Implementing: Some working code exists (e.g. backend and tests) but not every layer (API, persistence, UI) is done.
statusDefinitions.Implemented: Business logic, persistence, API and UI all functional.
statusDefinitions.Tested: Implemented and covered by automated tests that pass.
statusDefinitions.Integration pending: Built, awaiting an external provider integration.
statusDefinitions.External approval required: Needs credentials, regulatory or commercial approval outside the codebase.
statusDefinitions.Production ready: Acceptance criteria met and all required tests pass.

requirements.database: Tenant-scoped tables (org_id on every row, composite foreign keys), NUMERIC for money, audit events for every mutation.
requirements.api: Versioned REST endpoints under /v1/orgs/:orgId with zod validation, OpenAPI docs and permission checks.
requirements.ui: Role-appropriate screens in apps/web using the design system, with accessible tables behind every chart.
requirements.security: Tenant isolation, RBAC permission per action, append-only audit trail, no secrets in code.
requirements.tests: Unit tests for calculations; API integration tests for persistence, permissions and tenant isolation.

features.notes: Month-end closing agent: the AI model (Anthropic Claude) is shown the close checklist and how every account moved in the month against the three months before, points out what looks unusual, and proposes adjusting entries (accruals that reverse next month, prepayment releases, reclasses) using account codes only. Every entry is checked (allowed accounts, balanced, amounts, somewhere open to reverse) and posted only when a person approves it, through the normal journal code. Tested with a scripted model and a local Messages API stand-in; waiting on ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for a live check.

features.notes: HTTPS_ONLY (API: on in production when APP_URL is https; web: on in production builds): the web app redirects http:// visitors to https:// (308, localhost exempt) and sends HSTS on HTTPS responses; the API refuses non-HTTPS requests (X-Forwarded-Proto across trusted hops) with 403 HTTPS_REQUIRED except /health, and refuses to start with HTTPS_ONLY and TRUST_PROXY_HOPS=0. MONGODB_REQUIRE_TLS refuses an unencrypted MONGODB_URL at startup. System health shows how visitors, the database, email, the AI model, payment gateways and webhooks are protected, and lists HTTP or an unencrypted database as problems in production. TLS ends at the customer's load balancer; no mTLS, no TLS between web and API inside the private network unless T2T_API_URL is https.

features.notes: Reads the audit trail every SECURITY_MONITOR_INTERVAL_SECONDS (default 5 min). 23 audit actions are security events (HIGH or MEDIUM). Six rules raise alerts: many lockouts in an hour (SECURITY_LOCKOUT_ALERT_COUNT), failed two-step codes after a right password, platform role changes, a platform admin turning two-step off, infected uploads, 5+ SSO refusals in an hour for an organisation. One alert per rule and key (security_alerts; findings never change or get deleted), each new one emailed once to every super admin through the server's mail server. Platform admins review events and alerts; super admins acknowledge with a note (audited). No SIEM export, no pager or chat notifications, no anomaly detection beyond these rules.
